headline: VERTICES PARTNERS advises Marico on ₹113 crore stake acquisition in Cosmix
sum: Marico Limited has acquired an additional 20% stake in Cosmix Wellness Limited for ₹113.65 crore. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Marico on this transaction.
detail: Marico Limited has acquired an additional 20% stake in Cosmix Wellness Limited for ₹113.65 crore. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Marico on this transaction. The transaction was led by Vinayak Burman (Founder and Managing Partner), along with a team that included Vikrant Anand (Partner), Sajal Jain (Associate Manager) and Nishtha Khandelwal (Associate Manager). The Firm had also advised Marico on their earlier stake acquisition in Cosmix this year.
